exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Art Did you enjoy doing art lessons when you were a child? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you ever draw or paint pictures now? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: When was the last time you went to an art gallery or exhibition? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: What kind of pictures do you like having in your home? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a time when you visited a friend or family member at their workplace. You should say: who you visited where this person worked why you visited this person's workplace and explain how you felt about visiting this person's workplace.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Different kinds of workplaces What things make an office comfortable to work in?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Why do some people prefer to work outdoors?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that the building people work in is more important than the colleagues they work with?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: The importance of work What would life be like if people didn't have to work?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Are all jobs of equal importance?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Why do some people become workaholics?
